answer.text: The manual says the compass functions only when there is active navigation, so with navigation inactive it does not work.

disclaimers.text: The manual states this as a rule but does not explain the technical reason why the compass depends on active navigation.
Starting navigation is the condition the manual gives for the compass to function; it does not describe a fault or repair for this behaviour.
